title: What the Lord Requires
speaker: Pastor Wayne Holcomb
description:
What the Lord Requires | Justice, Mercy, Humility, and Obedience - Micah v6:8

Micah v6:8 calls us away from casual Christianity and into a life that truly honors God. He has already shown us what is good, and He requires more than empty religion. Our lives are to reflect justice, mercy, and humility as we walk closely with Him.

To do justly means our actions must be fair, moral, and shaped by truth in a confused world. To love mercy means we do not merely show compassion when it is convenient, but cherish the grace we have received and gladly extend it to others. To walk humbly with God means laying down pride, remembering that every blessing is from His hand, and living in daily dependence on Him.

Jesus fulfills this perfectly. At the cross He made payment for sin, showed mercy even to His enemies, and humbled Himself to serve. Since we are not graded on our goodness but on the cross, the only right response is to come to Him in faith and live the kind of life He requires.
